registers.label: Spare
lines: In the beginning was the Word.
And the Word was with God.
The light shines in the darkness.
And the darkness has not overcome it.
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet that bring good news.
Our God reigns.
Come, let us worship the Word made flesh.
Glory to God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Before there was a morning, before there was a single star, there was the Word — and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
Into the deepest dark a light is shining, and the dark has thrown everything it has at that light, and the light is still burning.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
How beautiful the feet of the runner on the mountain, shouting the news to the ends of the earth: your God reigns.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
The Word has pitched his tent among us, full of grace and truth, and we have seen his glory.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us. Glory to God!
